family: One fixed total guarded language evaluated by family.py. N<128 outputs0; larger inputs have L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),actual L-bit header S-1. With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^2),d=P2(S^9 L^6 z^2),Y=P2(S^11 L^9 z^3),k=P2(S^13 L^11 z^4). Initial D11 A1 has precisionceil(L/28)+10,exact rational field and adaptive B1,seedcap5L. Four shared-z internal maps retain t=floor(log2 L),rho=2^t,K128rho*M,raw-table guardK*B>=4rho*s*M; short E1 is direct B2.3. B5 is the fully supplied logarithmic-external-seed bootstrap: r-bit source padded to n=P2(r),w=ceil(log2 r),two1024-wise polynomial bit samplers,ell_s=n//2176000,kappa=ell_s//16000,weak outputM1=kappa//8,weak shared-field seedD1=5*(1000w)^2+2000w,direct A1D4 helper outputP2(D1),errorlog160w+10,and ceil((m-c)/M1) fresh external-seed rounds. Prefix hash degree1000w,lengthc250w supplies shifted agreement. Sampler scalar error and all entropy/helper guards are exact program checks. Entire G is generally nonlinear; only strong general extraction and shifted agreement are used. Layout delta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10. Initial matrix/field, B5prefix modulus,sampler field and helper A1 data are charged input bits; other internal maps have no data. Every failed plan outputs0,all headers/data are evaluated by one polynomial-time algorithm. A fixed good S0 is only a charged hard restriction. Eventuald0<4L,P<20L and initialbad2N^(-1/28) versus S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) close the bound.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^4. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^(4+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(11+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P<=20L eventually, hence P=O(L)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.
